meta.description: The student sees the published materials of their courses.

entete.titre: Class materials, and news from the school.
entete.accroche: The student sees the published materials of their courses.

cartes.texte: Documents are organised by programme and by module.
Five tabs: the board, the week, the scanner, the library, the account.
The teacher prepares the quiz. The link opens in a browser, on a school computer or elsewhere. A code or a QR code leads to the same link.

lignes.avant: Course materials arrive by message or on paper.
lignes.avec: The student sees the published materials of their courses.

lignes.avant: The school's documents sit in shared folders.
lignes.avec: Documents are organised by programme and by module.

lignes.avant: The week is read from a posted sheet.
lignes.avec: The students' application shows their week, scans the attendance QR code and opens the Library. Without a phone, the timetable and the resources open in a browser, and the teacher takes attendance by hand.

lignes.avant: Taking the quiz means installing an application.
lignes.avec: The link opens in a browser, on a school computer or elsewhere. A code or a QR code leads to the same link.

lignes.avant: News for a class goes out on a notice or in a message.
lignes.avec: An announcement goes to a class, a group or a programme. Email is optional.
